verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's own SDK and Wally CLI run models entirely on the user's hardware, offline and without an account, so the local runtime is effectively self-hostable. Nothing documents self-hosting the hosted Wally cloud inference service or gateway, which runs on RunAnywhere's hardware, and community reports note the MetalRT engine is commercial rather than open. Missing for 10: a documented self-hosted deployment of the hosted inference/API service, self-hosting docs or a deployment guide, and an openly available core engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: When a small model on your own machine is enough, the same CLI runs it, offline and without an account.
The RunAnywhere Kotlin SDK runs language, speech, and vision models on the device. Prompts, audio, and images stay on the phone, and everything keeps working with no network.
Private by default. Offline by design.
